query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.packageType,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.deductedMinutes,
  p.isActive,
  (p.usedHours - p.totalHours) AS outOfPackageMinutes,
  GREATEST(0, (p.usedHours - p.totalHours) - COALESCE(p.deductedMinutes, 0)) AS remainingOutOfPackage
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka' AND p.isActive = 0
ORDER BY p.endDate;
